observations.title: Pehkui role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Exposes entity scale types and commands for changing sizes; exact scaling types, permission checks and persistence must be taken from the installed version and server rules.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.

observations.title: Use server-authorized scale operations
observations.player_action: Have an authorized operator inspect the installed scale command and type before changing an entity's size.
observations.outcome: Scaling is expressed through specific scale types and affects supported entity properties; a visual model size change is not a verified promise about every mod's collision or combat integration.
conditions: Follow the installed consumer and server configuration; exact default keybindings and optional integration behavior were not runtime-verified.
